agentsBody: You describe the work, connect the apps it needs, and improve it through feedback. Share it with your team when it works.
agentsHeadline: Build an agent by chatting with it
automationsBody: An automation runs one of your agents without you asking — on a schedule, or when something happens in an app you have connected.
automationsHeadline: Put your agents to work in the background
sessionsBody: Each chat with an agent is a session. Pick one up where you left off, search across them, and inspect every model and tool call.
sessionsHeadline: Every conversation with an agent, in one place
skillsBody: Define your agent with AGENTS.md, skills, and MCP servers. You can bring skills and MCP servers from the agent ecosystem into Agenta.
skillsHeadline: Teach your agents how your team works
